name: Budget
description: Monthly envelope budgets: planned vs spent vs left per top-level expense category (converted to the default currency), a month-end forecast that includes planned (not yet paid) operations, an upcoming-operations list, a compact 13-month cashflow strip that selects the month in place and a detail with subcategories and transactions.
keyActions: see planned, spent and left per envelope for a month
set a monthly plan on an envelope
open an envelope to see subcategories and transactions
view the compact monthly cashflow strip
see what will be left at month end once planned operations are paid
mark upcoming operations paid or skip them from the budget
navigate between months from the month strip or arrows
